description: Stop without saying anything new: interrupt the turn the conversation is running (ACP's native session/cancel, the same path as a user pressing stop). The interrupted turn is recorded as cancelled; the text and tool calls it had produced stay in its result (dsh_get / sentinel), and files it changed are not rolled back. The conversation itself stays healthy and can take a new task right away. To stop and redirect use dsh_interject; to cancel a queued task that has not started use dsh_queue(action=remove).

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.
